speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise during your pregnancy; could you please tell me how many weeks pregnant you are and when these symptoms began?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is concerning; did you experience a specific type of headache, such as a stiff neck, or any sensitivity to light and sound? Also, please confirm if you have noticed any rash, jaundice, or if there are any changes in your fetal movement.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis.

Given your 30-week pregnancy, sudden onset of fever, headache, and anorexia following dairy consumption, you have a high risk for Listeria monocytogenes infection. I need to confirm if your urine is negative to rule out a UTI and to see if there is any fetal distress.

REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, CBC with differential, Serum Lactate Dehydrogenase (LDH), and Blood Culture.
REQUEST IMAGES: Ultrasound to assess fetal well-being and amniotic fluid status.
